description: It is 5:30 in the morning. Across the bedroom, two lifeless figures are propped against the furniture, staring straight ahead with wide, empty eyes.

At 2:30 AM, a scream tore through the hallway. A detour into the dark bathroom revealed heavy, wet trails smeared across the carpet. Now, a hairless, eyeless creature has arranged its grotesque masterpiece across the bedroom walls, and slithered directly beneath the mattress… waiting for the first sign of movement.
A Scroll Kaos paper-cutout horror story. Watch until the very end.
